description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Modernize the application to the latest supported Java framework and runtime baseline.
tasks.reason: The current Java 8 and legacy servlet baseline limits long-term support and cloud modernization readiness.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade the application baseline to the latest supported Java runtime/framework for this project and align build configuration for the upgraded baseline while preserving existing business behavior.

tasks.description: Migrate plaintext and environment-based application credentials to Azure Key Vault.
tasks.reason: Centralized secret management reduces credential exposure risk and supports Azure-native operations.
tasks.requirements: Migrate sensitive application credentials and connection secrets from local properties/environment patterns to Azure Key Vault backed retrieval.

tasks.description: Modernize database connectivity to Azure SQL with managed identity authentication.
tasks.reason: Passwordless identity-based access improves security posture and cloud-native alignment.
tasks.requirements: Adopt managed identity-based authentication for Azure SQL connectivity and remove direct password dependency from runtime configuration.

tasks.description: Scan dependencies for known CVEs and remediate identified vulnerabilities.
tasks.reason: Security remediation is required before production modernization deployment.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade vulnerable dependencies to patched versions, document any major-version remediation risks, and verify build and tests succeed after remediation.

tasks.description: Deploy the modernized application to Azure Container Apps.
tasks.reason: Azure Container Apps provides a cloud-native managed platform for containerized Java workloads.
tasks.requirements: Containerize and deploy the modernized application to Azure Container Apps with production-ready runtime settings and secure service integration.
